cal appearance of old friends met again, not of
strangers just introduced. The dav bears every
aspect of gala time. The streets along the route
nave been well swept, and the passenger cars will
be prevented from running during the procession.

AN UNFORTUNATE CHILD.-The New York papers
state that there is universal sympathy manifested
for the little girl, the child Of Stephens who was
hanged on Friday, for poisoning his wife, She is a
very pretty child, and hardly old enough yet to
thoroughly comprehend the sad fate of her guilty
parent and Often when she sat upon his knee in the
cell, asked him with fearful eyes, "Pa, why are you
here?" the rough jailors were obliged to turn
their heads away. Poor little thing Just as she
needs mothers and fathers protection both
are removed to another world. The little waif, as
she may properly be called, is left to plod her
way along life's dreary journey, borne down with
shame and grief Stephens himself did not seem to
express much sympathy, being callous to degree.

CHARLoTrErowN, August 1O.-Tbe Prince OF
Wales landed at o'clock on Thursday from the
Hero. The Admirals ship Nile, and the Adriadne,
Cossack, Valorous, and Flying Fish, accompanied
him, as also the French Commodore's ship POmene.
The day was stormy and wet. There was a multi
tude of visitors from abroad. The steamer Ara
bian brought six hundred presons from Quebec,
and the Westmoreland four hundred from Bruins
wick. Some of the excursionists had to camp out.


The preparations for the Princes reception were
good. The Prince, who wore Colonel's uniform,
landed under eight royal salutes from the ships and
battery, including French ship. He was received
on Queens wharf by the officers of Government,
members of the public bodies members of the clergy
and bar, and deputations of prominent Citizens
He was conveyed in the Governors carriage and
accompanied by procession along the streets,
which were lined by the volunteers battalion and
numerous tasteful arches were erected.


The balconies of the houses were filled with ladies
and children. A number of the latter sang the ma
tional anthem. A guard of honor of regular troops
accompanied the Prince from Halifax. The Prince
rode out in plain clothes this afternoon in the rain
Governor Mugrave and other celebrities are here.
The reception is considered complete success.
